tools.name: search_public_tenders
tools.description: Search recent French public-procurement notices in the official DILA BOAMP open dataset. Keyword in notice title; returns bounded, sourced records with publication and deadline. Free beta, not exhaustive, no private data or scraped websites.

tools.name: data_sources
tools.description: Describe the official BOAMP dataset, provenance, reuse conditions and limitations of this experimental public tender search.

tools.name: ecosystem_catalog
tools.description: Find related MCP services: Agent Guardian (contract audit), Agent Repair (failed tool calls), Agent Signals (public-data search) and Agent Dependency Radar (dependency checks). No automatic redirect or payment.
